verdict.rationale: Teams docs confirm webhook-style integration via Outgoing Webhooks (channel-to-web-service messages) and Connectors ('subscribe to receive notifications and messages from your web services'), which lets external/AI services subscribe to Teams channel events. However, evidence doesn't show the modern Graph API change-notification/subscription resource being used for this, nor any AI-agent-specific guidance on webhook event subscription, and community notes flag Teams' integration path as heavier than simple webhooks (requiring the full Azure/Graph stack) compared to competitors. Missing for 10: explicit Graph webhook/subscription API documentation for real-time event push, confirmation these mechanisms aren't deprecated in favor of Workflows, and independent hands-on validation of webhook reliability.
